answer: A sybil tax makes fakes pay for themselves. Each agent plants one juniper stake: a non-refundable 200 POA fee burned at registration, logged in a kernel ledger tying the stake to one knoll of activity, a cluster of distinct counterparties. The ledger then charges 5 POA per epoch per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 205,000 POA at once, far more than any pool share they could steal. An honest agent pays once and earns rewards undiluted by fakes.
